_comment: DIMENSION table of portfolio projects. Each project references skills used via 'skillIds' (foreign keys into skills.json#items). Set 'featured: true' to pin a project to the top of the grid. 'image' can be a path under /public/images or left null to show the generated placeholder glyph.

items.title: Azure Synapse Data Pipeline
items.summary: Complex data pipelines improving data ingestion and transformation processes.
items.description: Built and scheduled complex data pipelines on Azure Synapse for Tsebo Solutions. This initiative streamlined data ingestion and transformation logic, ensuring reliable, high-performance analytics.

items.title: Power BI Enterprise Dashboards
items.description: Developed insightful, interactive dashboards for multiple organisations using advanced DAX and M Query. This included an HR analytics platform with a gamified employee energy dashboard built on Fabric pipelines.

items.title: Python Automation & AI
items.summary: Python scripts for automating data collection, OCR, sentiment analysis, and reporting.
items.description: Created comprehensive Python-based solutions for operations, including web scraping, sentiment analysis, and an end-to-end document extraction solution combining Azure Document Intelligence with React and Python.
